pageProps.content: ## Ordered ```menu { "title": "Iced Long Black", "rating": 4.0 } --- A clean, rich, and reliably satisfying long black. ``` ```menu { "title": "Crème Brûlée Cheesecake", "rating": 3.5 } --- A rich crème brûlée cheesecake recommended by the owner as an alternative to tiramisu. ``` ## Review I originally planned to visit a different cafe, but since all seats were full, I inevitably came to a nearby cafe. There is no dedicated parking lot, so you have to find parking in nearby open spaces on your own. However, since it has a cozy rural alley vibe, parking didn't seem too difficult. From the atmosphere of the cafe, it had a strong impression that the owner had lived in Australia before returning. Fortunately, there were plenty of seats and it was quiet and peaceful, so I comfortably grabbed a table and placed an order. For coffee, I ordered an Iced Long Black. ```adcard ``` For dessert, I wanted to have `Tiramisu Cake`, but unfortunately it was sold out. Inevitably, I ordered the Crème Brûlée Cheesecake recommended by the owner. Perhaps because the owner runs the cafe alone, it took quite a while from ordering until the items were served. This too felt somewhat Australian in a way. The long black that came out after the long wait was delicious as expected. The shape of the cup was a bit unique, and it felt surprisingly nice in the hand. The `Crème Brûlée Cheesecake` was also just as delicious as the owner had recommended. The weather was so hot that I couldn't even think of stepping outside. Thanks to that, I spent a long, leisurely time sitting in the cafe. ## Pictures
